Title: Public preview: Incremental snapshots for Premium SSD v2 Disk Storage

Body.Content:
We are announcing the preview of incremental snapshots for Premium SSD v2 Disk Storage in the US East and West Europe Azure region. This new capability is particularly important to customers who want to create a backup copy of their data stored on disks to recover from accidental deletes, or to have a last line of defense against ransomware attacks, or to ensure business continuity. You can now create incremental snapshots for Premium SSD v2 Disk Storage on Standard HDD. Additionally, snapshot resources can be used to store incremental backups of your disk, create or recover to new disks, or download snapshots to on-premises locations. This new feature adds an extra layer of data protection and flexibility for users.

To learn more, read the documentation
